package repository

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// This test is compiled only into the checked-out 2de33bb test binary. It
// consumes a wire read by the current source from its disposable PostgreSQL.
func TestLABCoreBoundLegacyDecode(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("LAB_DISPOSAL_WIRE")
	if path == "" {
		t.Fatal("disposable wire required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var legacy FailedInstalledGuestDisposal
	err = decodeFailedInstalledDisposal(raw, &legacy)
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), `unknown field "replacement_mode"`) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy source did not reject the new persisted wire: %v", err)
	}
	// A separately encoded legacy-only in-memory representation remains
	// readable, isolating the source incompatibility from test setup errors.
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &legacy); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	oldWire, err := json.Marshal(legacy)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var roundtrip FailedInstalledGuestDisposal
	if err = decodeFailedInstalledDisposal(oldWire, &roundtrip); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("legacy decoder control refused: %v", err)
	}
	t.Log("LAB_CORE2DE_REAL_PG_WIRE_UNKNOWN_FIELDS_HELD_CONTROL_PASS")
}
